name: Dark Waters: Gino and the Witch of the Black Swamp
source:
You play Gino Castallo, a young man tortured by his own mundane existence. Another ghost-hunting expedition has you turn up empty-handed yet again, and you begin the slow trek home. On your way back you encounter a murky body of water, and the witch of the black swamp, herself, Cuca Rivers. The beautiful woman promises to show you all kinds of wonderful magic.

Everything is just as it seems, right...?

[From [url=https://outismedia.itch.io/witch-of-the-swamp-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演吉诺·卡斯塔洛，一个被平庸生活折磨的年轻人。又一次探寻幽灵的远征一无所获，你只得缓缓踏上归途。回家的路上，你遇见一片浑浊的水域，以及黑沼泽魔女本人——库卡·里弗斯。这位美丽的女子承诺，会向你展示种种奇妙的魔法。

一切都如表面所见，对吧……？

[译自[url=https://outismedia.itch.io/witch-of-the-swamp-vn]itch.io[/url]]
